instruction: Create app/admin/zones/page.tsx in jong-jaroen (c:/Users/PC/Desktop/jong-jaroen). Admin page for zone management. Show all jj_zones in a table: name, zone_type, is_active, parent_id (show parent zone name). Each row: toggle is_active button (calls Supabase update). Use sbServer() for data fetch, sbAdmin for mutations via server action or API route. Dark theme, orange accent (#f97316). When done trigger back to claude with [DONE] tag.
